name: Zwei: The Ilvard Insurrection
summary: In a world where magic and technology exist side by side, vampire princess Alwen must reclaim her ancestral castle and her magic alongside her unlikely ally, treasure hunter Ragna Valentine. They may make for an odd pair, but when they combine their talents, the sky’s the limit!

name: Zwackery
summary: A fantasy-type game with all the fairy tale elements. Jump around and preserve all the pages of Zak's "Book of Life" from the Gholum.

name: Zwei!!: The Arges Adventure
summary: Boasting a completely standalone story set on a mysterious “low fantasy” island floating amongst the clouds, Zwei: The Arges Adventure plays out as a classically styled action-oriented 2D dungeon crawler with oodles of optional content and unlockables, player-defined challenge through a unique food-based experience system, and a pervading tongue-in-cheek humor style that helps set it apart from other entries in the genre.

name: Zwei!! Online
summary: A Korean MMORPG based on Falcom's Zwei!!

name: Z.W!
summary: Full ahead! Kill'em all! Fight as long as possible!

name: Zwart Wit
summary: It looks simple to get to the exit in the first few levels, but it keeps getting harder! If you don't have a good brain and a quick finger then forget about playing this.

name: Z-Warp
summary: Z-Warp is an intense vertical shoot'em up presented in retro pixel art style, featuring frenetic arcade-inspired action where blasters, bombs and killer specials are your only allies. Shoot down demonic enemies as they try to overwhelm your ship with bullet hell salvos and turn the tide of battle by charging your killer weapon capable of instantly wiping out anything in a tight radius around your ship! Face massive boss abominations and aim for high scores in Story or Endless modes.

name: Zwaard
summary: Explore a world where you try to preserve the still existing life forms. Technology has taken over and will try it's best to stop you in your adventure. Whilst those technologies try to stop you they could also be the only reason you're still alive.

name: Z World Zombie: Death War
summary:
Z World Zombie Death War is the ultimate 2D game in zombie survival.
Caught in the midst of an epic zombie outbreak in an unknown city, your only thought is: Survive!
In this game, players are tasked with fighting off a zombie invasion and reaching the subway to escape the city.

name: Z World
summary: Supernatural aerial combat open world action adventurer. Defend the city against monstrous invasions. This game features interactive NPCs, levitation powers, and avatar choices. Explore.

name: Z War Apocalypse Shooter
summary: Get ready to face the undead – the fight for survival begins now!

name: Zwift
summary: Where fitness meets adventure. There’s never a dull day of indoor training in the amazing worlds of Zwift. Explore endless roads and unlock your fitness goals.

name: Zwei Trigger
summary:
Set in a rapidly developing city plagued by an abnormally high number of disappearances, this mystery visual novel follows two intertwined tales of resolve and tragedy. Kurusu Yuuma searches desperately for his missing sister-figure, Akizuki Kaname, only to be drawn into a web of unexplained vanishings. Meanwhile, Takanashi Shin’ya delves into the same enigma in hopes of saving Akesaka Touka, a girl afflicted by a mysterious illness linked to the supernatural.

Written by Kazuki Fumi, the story features a dual protagonist system, weaving together two perspectives that gradually uncover the dark secrets lurking beneath the city’s surface.

name: Zwamman
summary: Zwamman is a zero pressure single screen puzzle game in which you have to use your light to help Zwamman find crystals in dark forests and swamps. Use the crystals to light a path to Zwamman's home and reveal the true nature of the scary monsters!

name: Zwiadowca
summary:
Zwiadowca is a story-driven modification for Gothic II: Night of the Raven created by Racer75, telling the story of Jergan, Garond's scout. The action takes place after the Nameless One sails to the Irdorath Court, when the orcs invade Khorinis. The mod offers new quests, a character focused on dexterity and few unique mechanics.
Features:
- 10+ hours of gameplay
- characters known from Gothic II and former convicts from Gothic I
- high difficulty and about 45 quests that require cunning
- gaining muscle mass while building strength
- unlimited lifespan of summoned undead
- new transformation and summoning scrolls
- ability to acquire armor from Gothic 1 and Gothic 2
- two possible endings
